scripts.check: nx affected -t typecheck lint test --base=$(git branch --show-current | grep -qx main && echo HEAD~1 || echo main)
scripts.check:full: nx run-many -t typecheck lint test && pnpm py:test && nx run-many -t test:contract
scripts.py:test: test -x python/analysis/.venv/bin/python || { echo 'Python environment missing: run pnpm py:setup first' >&2; exit 1; } && python/analysis/.venv/bin/python -m pytest python/analysis
